<p><b>Example reports third quarter results</b></p>
<p>CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA &mdash; Example today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 27, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $109.4 billion, up 16 percent year over year, and diluted earnings per share of $2.02. &ldquo;Today, Example is proud to report its strongest June quarter ever,&rdquo; said the CEO.</p>
